name: Lacustrine-Brae

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws tidally locked hemisphere, patient as erosion itself.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in titanium and solar potential and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
